name: True Literature Club
source:
Doki Doki Literature Club deals with a lot of dark themes; depression, suicide, self-harm, abuse, etc. This is a story which deals with these topics (and more!) in a sensitive manner. This mod is not intended as a guide for how to deal with any of these issues; it's merely a story of teenagers who are trying to deal with these situations as best as they can. It is intended to be a bit of a feels train, but the stories for all four girls have happy endings and, most importantly, none of them die.

[Edited from the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/88hvry/true_literature_club_tlc_mod_full_release_a_more/]original post[/url]]
translation:
《心跳文学部》涉及许多沉重的主题，如抑郁、自杀、自伤、虐待等。本作以细腻审慎的态度讲述这些话题，以及更多内容。这个模组并非处理上述问题的指南，只是讲述一群尽自己所能应对这些处境的青少年的故事。它的确想让你经历一场情绪起伏，但四位女孩的故事都有幸福的结局，最重要的是，她们谁也不会死。

[编译自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/88hvry/true_literature_club_tlc_mod_full_release_a_more/]原帖[/url]]
